design_brief: Match the existing golden retriever and warm gouache storybook art. Mage in a muted teal robe with a wooden amber staff; archer in a moss green cloak with bow and quiver. Each has eight right-facing poses: idle, alert, running A/B, prepare attack, release attack, celebrate, sleep. Whole figures inside separate transparent cells. No lettering or frames.
note: Design brief records the intended art direction, not a verbatim generation prompt.
